meta.name: Segment donors and generate personalized messages with Google Sheets and Ollama

nodes.name: Merge Draft With Donor Data
nodes.notes: FIX: Basic LLM Chain does not pass through input fields -- it only outputs its own result (text), dropping Email/Name/etc. This node recombines that text output with the original donor row from Build Prompt, matched by item position (both branches process the same 61 items in the same order, so position-based combining is safe here). Input 1 (index 0) = Basic LLM Chain; Input 2 (index 1) = Build Prompt. Combine mode/param names are a best-effort reconstruction -- verify 'Combine by Position' is selected in the node UI after import, since exact parameter keys can vary by n8n version.

nodes.name: Basic LLM Chain2
nodes.notes: ARCHITECTURE.md 2.11 (updated). No batching/retry/rate-limit -- items run one at a time via n8n's normal per-item execution against local Ollama.

nodes.name: Validate & Clean
nodes.notes: ARCHITECTURE.md 2.3. Continue On Fail = true from here downstream. Duplicate detection is full-row (every field must match), not email-only.

parameters.content:
# Get, Clean, Validate rows from Google Sheet 
* Confirms required fields, normalizes types, dedupes by full-row match, tags each row with validation_status instead of dropping silently

* Valid rows are sent to RFM Scoring (Recency, Frequency, Monetary)

* Invalid rows are recorded in a new sheet called "Invalid Rows" within the document

# Donor Segmentation  

* Categorize donors with RFM and Behavioral Segmentation

nodes.name: Segment to Treatment Mapping
nodes.notes: ARCHITECTURE.md 2.8. Edit TREATMENT_TABLE to match org voice.

nodes.name: RFM Segmentation
nodes.notes: ARCHITECTURE.md 2.5. Run Once for All Items.

nodes.name: Llama3.1
nodes.notes: Confirmed working: llama3.1:latest, numPredict=300 (uncapped -1 caused streaming errors). Verify exact parameter names against your installed node version.

nodes.name: Validate LLM Output
nodes.notes: ARCHITECTURE.md 2.12. Reads the `text` field from Basic LLM Chain.

nodes.name: Fallback Template
nodes.notes: ARCHITECTURE.md 3.2 (no retry loop). Applies immediately for any item flagged _llm_failed; passes others through unchanged.

nodes.name: Shape Final Output
nodes.notes: Outputs Email + personalized_message (plus tracking fields) for write-back.

# Construct prompt for AI model to generate personalized messages

* Build LLM prompt per donor by Injecting segment, tone, ask type, and relevant donor facts into a template

* Flags items for retry vs. fallback-to-template
